tagline.en_US: HandBrake is an open-source tool designed to convert video from nearly any format to modern, widely supported codecs.

description.en_US: HandBrake is an open-source tool designed to convert video from nearly any format to modern, widely supported codecs. It enables users to process, re-encode, and optimize video files for seamless playback across different devices and media players.
